title: Leaving for New York, and the childhood visit
summary: He sold the car in Indianapolis, went home and then to New York, where he had first been as a kid around 1925-26.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I went to Indianapolis. I went to Indianapolis, sold the car, and went home to Pittsburgh. From Pittsburgh I took the train or the bus or something, and went to New York.
Was that your first time in New York?
Yeah, I was there when I was a kid, when Joe was working. They let me play "Sweet Sue"!
When was that? When you were real little?
No, '25 or '26. Not too little. What I remember about New York then was that... I don't know, you could put your nickel in and get the food out. I thought that was magic, you know.
